mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of observations where FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month average unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession probability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic weakness that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline from prior month levels.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 250.0 (index 1982-1984=100), it indicates sustained high inflation that triggers aggressive Federal Reserve tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 250.0.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly job gains below 50,000 (PAYEMS) signal weak labor market momentum that increases economic uncertainty, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS < 50,000.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in monthly job gains (PAYEMS) indicates accelerating labor market deterioration that increases recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines from prior month levels.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1,200,000 units signal weak consumer demand for housing, a leading indicator of economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1,200.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that signals economic weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0.
